connector.name: Jitbit Helpdesk
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Jitbit Helpdesk: search, list, read, and reply to support tickets from AI assistants.
connector.summary: Hosted at {helpdesk_host} over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package jitbit-helpdesk-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jitbit account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API token from your Jitbit user profile, for example Bearer your-api-token

env.name: JITBIT_URL
env.description: Base URL of your Jitbit Helpdesk instance

env.name: JITBIT_TOKEN
env.description: API token from your Jitbit user profile
